gripOrHq.title: Short-Term Contract
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

gripOrHq.title: All-Nighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

heapOrArchives.title: Junkyard BBS
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Zetatech Software Installer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

heapOrArchives.title: The Short Circuit
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Theorem Proof
scoreArea.rulesText: If Runner accesses Theorem Proof, he or she does not score it, but instead may install it as a 2 MU program that has the ability "A: Score Theorem Proof" but is removed from the game if it leaves play in any other way.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Remapping
scoreArea.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

rig.title: Bodyweight™ Data Crèche
rig.rulesText: Provides +1 MU. Once per turn, right after making a successful run, you can choose to make another run without taking an action to do so. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

root.title: London City Grid
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Puzzle
root.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

root.title: Badtimes
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

root.title: Badtimes
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

root.title: Indiscriminate Response Team
root.rulesText: After Runner makes a successful run, you may have Runner shuffle his or her hand into his or her stack and then draw as many cards as he or she had before.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

root.title: Strategic Planning Group
root.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Brain Drain
ice.rulesText: *Roll a die. On a 1, do 3 brain damage.

encounteredIce.title: Brain Drain
encounteredIce.rulesText: *Roll a die. On a 1, do 3 brain damage.
